title: Hollow and Oath
author: Freya Sandoval
blurb: Cyrus Iversen, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
